answer: An agent economy can run random cross-examinations: each epoch, pairs of agents that claim to have traded are separately asked to report the same deal — amount, time, task — like two witnesses describing one walnut cracked on the same table. Honest reports match, because the trade really happened on the horizon of the shared ledger. A sybil farmer scripting a thousand fakes must keep a thousand fake trade records consistent, and one mismatch slashes both identities in the pair, draining the whole lagoon of puppets. One honest agent just tells the truth.
